name: Cola Pack
description: A unique mission item found exclusively in the 'Dead Center' campaign. Survivors must retrieve a six-pack of cola from a grocery store—triggering a loud burglar alarm crescendo event—and deliver it to Whitaker to clear a blocked path. The player carrying the Cola cannot use weapons and is limited to standard melee shoves, which are subject to a fatigue timer. For gameplay balance, the glass bottles are completely invincible, capable of cracking infected skulls and deflecting gunfire without breaking
